newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Femsa chair still recovering in hospital.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Femsa chair still recovering in hospital.

text.p: Eugenio Garza Laguera, the chairman of Fomento Economico Mexicano (Femsa), is still recovering from the heart attack he suffered on April 11, the company's CFO said Wednesday.
"As far as we know, Don Eugenio continues to recover," Alfredo Livas told reporters, adding he was "well" and remains in a hospital in Houston, Texas.
The 73-year-old businessman is also chairman of the board of Grupo Financiero Bancomer, Mexico's second largest banking institution.
He is also president of the influential Monterrey Technical Institute, one of the country's top seats of learning, especially for business students.
Family members have said he will return to his native Monterrey soon and is eager to return to oversee his businesses.
